text.magicaland_gameplay.config.title: Magical Land · Gameplay settings
text.magicaland_gameplay.config.ability_: Sets the starting view for your next projection. You can still switch views while projecting; returning restores the body's original view. Changes save automatically.
text.magicaland_gameplay.config.save_fai: Could not save. Check config folder permissions and retry.
text.magicaland_gameplay.wheel.hint: Point at the top ability and release to select, not cast
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.name: Remote presence
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.select: Hold %s and select Remote presence first
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.server: This server does not support remote control
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.busy: Remote control is at capacity; try again later
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.grant: Ability not granted. Test command: /magicaland remote_tool grant @s
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.stance: Stand on dry ground without riding, flying, taking damage or using an item
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.blocked: Not enough unobstructed space in front of you
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.wait: Establishing connection... Press %s again to cancel
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.controls: Attack: mine / melee · Use: interact · Scroll / numbers: slot · %s: drop one (Ctrl: stack) · %s: return
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.blind: Fully obscured · Backtrack to see; moving deeper returns you · %s: return
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.occupied: No remote slot can hold this item. Make inventory space, then project empty-handed and return to collect retained items.
text.magicaland_gameplay.remote.cargo_re: Inventory full. Remaining items are safe in your remote hotbar; make room, then project and return to collect them.
